heading: none
name: 超大標題跑馬燈＋散置圖片
desc: 一行超大標題文字持續橫向流動、超出畫面兩側，周圍高低錯開散置三張橫式圖片，文字壓在中央圖片上緣。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊中段是一行跑馬燈：同一段超大標題文字首尾相接重複，持續往同一方向水平流動，只有一列，橫跨整個畫面寬並被畫面左右邊緣裁切；文字明顯大於一般標題。跑馬燈周圍散置三張橫式圖片，高低錯開：一張在上方偏左，貼齊畫面左緣並被左緣裁切；一張在上方靠右，是三張中最大的，約佔畫面寬的三分之一多，右側不貼邊；一張在跑馬燈下方、水平約置中，跑馬燈文字在它前面，蓋住圖片上緣的一部分。
mobile: 結構不變，等比縮放：跑馬燈仍為一列、持續流動並被畫面左右邊緣裁切；三張圖片縮小並維持高低錯開的散置，上方偏左的圖片貼齊畫面左緣，上方靠右的圖片改為貼齊畫面右緣並被右緣裁切，下方的圖片移到偏左，跑馬燈文字仍蓋住它的上緣。觸控裝置上取消跟隨游標的按鈕效果。

en.name: Oversized headline marquee with scattered images
en.desc: A single row of oversized headline text flows continuously sideways past both screen edges, with three landscape images scattered at staggered heights around it; the text overlaps the top edge of the center image.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. In the middle of the section is a single-row marquee: the same oversized headline text repeats end to end and flows continuously in one horizontal direction, spanning the full screen width and cropped by the left and right screen edges; the text is clearly larger than a normal title. Three landscape images are scattered around the marquee at staggered heights: one at the upper left, flush with the left screen edge and cropped by it; one at the upper right, the largest of the three at a little over a third of the screen width, not touching the right edge; and one below the marquee, roughly centered horizontally, with the marquee text in front of it, covering part of its top edge.
en.mobile: The structure stays the same and scales proportionally: the marquee remains a single row, keeps flowing, and is cropped by the left and right screen edges; the three images shrink and keep their staggered scattered placement, the upper-left image stays flush with the left screen edge, the upper-right image becomes flush with the right screen edge and is cropped by it, the lower image moves toward the left, and the marquee text still covers its top edge. On touch devices, the cursor-following button effect is cancelled.

extras.name: 跟隨游標的圓形箭頭按鈕
extras.prompt: 區塊裡放一顆深色的大圓形按鈕，中間是一個箭頭圖示，上方有一段沿圓弧排列的小字標籤。按鈕預設在區塊中央，疊在跑馬燈文字和下方圖片的前面；游標在區塊內時，按鈕跟著游標移動，游標不在區塊內時按鈕縮小淡出。
extras.tablet: 平板在觸控裝置上取消跟隨游標，按鈕固定在區塊中央。
extras.mobile: 手機版不顯示這顆圓形按鈕。

en.name: Cursor-following circular arrow button
en.prompt: Place a large dark circular button in the section, with an arrow icon in the middle and a small label above it set along the arc of the circle. By default the button sits in the center of the section, in front of the marquee text and the lower image; while the cursor is inside the section, the button follows the cursor, and when the cursor is not inside the section the button shrinks and fades out.
en.tablet: On touch devices, the tablet cancels cursor following and keeps the button fixed in the center of the section.
en.mobile: On mobile, this circular button is not shown.
